headline: A 2022 law renames a federal office building in Minneapolis after former Senator Paul Wellstone.
what_it_does: The law designates the federal building at 212 Third Avenue South in Minneapolis, Minnesota, as the Paul D. Wellstone Federal Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change how the building is used, staffed, or funded.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 20, 2022.
